summary: The UK has extended the shortage protocol for 1.25mg ramipril capsules until October 2026. Learn why supplies remain limited, what it means for patients, and the steps to take if your medication is affected. Health authorities have extended the Serious Shortage Protocol (SSP) for 1.25mg ramipril capsules until October 30, 2026
body_text: The UK has extended the shortage protocol for 1.25mg ramipril capsules until October 2026. Learn why supplies remain limited, what it means for patients, and the steps to take if your medication is affected. Thousands of people across the United Kingdom who rely on ramipril for managing high blood pressure and other heart conditions continue to face limited medicine supplies. Health authorities have extended the Serious Shortage Protocol (SSP) for 1.25mg ramipril capsules until October 30, 2026, meaning pharmacies will continue dispensing only one month's supply at a time. The shortage has raised concerns among healthcare professionals, pharmacists, and patients alike. While alternative medicines and formulations are available in some cases, pharmacists warn that ongoing supply issues are placing additional strain on healthcare services and creating uncertainty for people who depend on this commonly prescribed medication. This article explains what the shortage means, why it is happening, and how patients can manage their prescriptions safely. What Is Ramipril? Ramipril is a prescription medicine widely used to treat several cardiovascular and kidney conditions. It belongs to a group of medicines known as ACE inhibitors, which help relax blood vessels and reduce blood pressure. By lowering blood pressure, ramipril helps reduce the risk of serious complications such as heart attacks, strokes, heart failure, and kidney damage. It is commonly prescribed for: High blood pressure (hypertension) Heart failure Protection after a heart attack Certain kidney conditions, especially in people with diabetes Because hypertension often develops without noticeable symptoms, many patients rely on medications like ramipril for long term control. Why Has the Shortage Been Extended? The shortage of 1.25mg ramipril capsules was first identified earlier in 2026. Health authorities introduced a Serious Shortage Protocol to help ensure available supplies were distributed fairly among patients. The protocol has now been extended until the end of October because supply has not yet returned to normal levels. Under the current arrangements, pharmacists are instructed to provide only one month's supply at a time. This temporary measure is intended to reduce the risk of some patients receiving more medication than they immediately need while others struggle to access treatment. Although only the 1.25mg capsule strength is affected under the protocol, healthcare professionals continue to monitor supplies of other formulations and alternative medicines. Why Are Medicine Shortages Becoming More Common? Medicine shortages have become increasingly common across many countries over the past few years. According to pharmacy organizations, several factors may contribute to supply disruptions, including: Global manufacturing delays Limited production capacity Increased patient demand Supply chain disruptions Transportation challenges International geopolitical instability Shortages of pharmaceutical ingredients When one medicine becomes difficult to obtain, patients may be switched to alternatives. This can increase demand for substitute medicines and create additional pressure on supplies. What Does This Mean for Patients? For most patients, the shortage does not mean treatment will suddenly stop. Instead, pharmacies are carefully managing available stock to ensure as many people as possible continue receiving their medication. Patients may notice that: They receive only a one month supply. Their pharmacy needs extra time to source stock. Their doctor may recommend a different strength or formulation. Their prescription could be changed to an alternative medication if appropriate. Healthcare professionals stress that patients should continue taking their medication exactly as prescribed unless advised otherwise by their doctor or pharmacist. Do Not Stop Taking Ramipril Without Medical Advice One of the biggest concerns during medicine shortages is that some patients may consider stopping treatment on their own. Stopping blood pressure medication without professional guidance can increase the risk of uncontrolled hypertension and serious complications. These complications may include: Heart attack Stroke Heart failure Kidney damage If your pharmacy cannot immediately supply your medication, speak with the pharmacist or your prescribing clinician. They can discuss suitable alternatives if necessary. The Importance of Managing High Blood Pressure High blood pressure is often called a silent condition because many people experience no symptoms for years. Without treatment, consistently elevated blood pressure can damage blood vessels and increase the risk of: Heart disease Stroke Kidney disease Vision problems Dementia Regular blood pressure monitoring and taking prescribed medicines consistently remain essential for reducing these risks. Lifestyle Habits That Support Healthy Blood Pressure Medication is only one part of blood pressure management. Healthy lifestyle choices can also help improve cardiovascular health. Some recommended habits include: Reduce Salt Intake Eating less salt may help lower blood pressure. Many processed foods contain significant amounts of sodium, so checking food labels can be beneficial. Stay Physically Active Regular exercise supports heart health and circulation. Walking, cycling, swimming, and other moderate activities can contribute to better blood pressure control. Maintain a Healthy Weight Achieving and maintaining a healthy body weight can reduce strain on the heart and improve overall cardiovascular health. Limit Alcohol Excessive alcohol consumption may increase blood pressure over time. Following recommended drinking guidelines can help reduce health risks. Stop Smoking Smoking damages blood vessels and increases the risk of cardiovascular disease. Quitting smoking offers significant long term health benefits. Attend Regular Health Checks Adults should have their blood pressure checked periodically, particularly if they have risk factors such as obesity, diabetes, or a family history of hypertension. What Pharmacists Are Saying Pharmacy organizations have expressed concern that ongoing medicine shortages continue to create additional workloads for community pharmacies. Pharmacists often spend considerable time searching for available stock, contacting prescribers, and arranging alternative treatments when medicines become unavailable. Healthcare professionals continue to encourage improved coordination across the medicine supply chain to reduce disruptions and ensure patients receive timely treatment. Frequently Asked Questions Is ramipril being recalled? No. The current issue relates to limited supply of certain 1.25mg capsules rather than a product recall. Can I switch to another medicine? Only your doctor or prescribing clinician should decide whether an alternative medication is appropriate for your condition. Should I stockpile ramipril? No. Patients should collect medicines only as prescribed. Stockpiling may worsen shortages for others. What should I do if my pharmacy has no stock? Speak with your pharmacist. They may be able to source stock from another supplier or contact your prescriber about suitable alternatives. Final Thoughts The extension of the Serious Shortage Protocol for 1.25mg ramipril capsules highlights the ongoing challenges affecting medicine supplies across the healthcare system. While temporary restrictions may be frustrating, they are intended to help ensure fair access for patients who rely on this important medication. Patients should continue taking their medicine as prescribed, stay in contact with their pharmacy, and seek medical advice before making any changes to their treatment. With careful management and collaboration between healthcare providers, most patients can continue receiving appropriate care while supply issues are addressed. Sources Department of Health and Social Care (DHSC) NHS England prescribing and hypertension information National Pharmacy Association (NPA) Independent Pharmacies Association (IPA) Community Pharmacy England Disclaimer This article is intended for informational and educational purposes only and should not be considered medical advice. Medication availability and clinical guidance may change over time. Always consult your GP, pharmacist, or another qualified healthcare professional before starting, stopping, or changing any prescribed medication.

title: What Is Quenching? A Guide to Heat Treatment and Quenching Oils
summary: In heat‑treat operations, quenching is the point where material properties are finalized. The way steel is cooled after heating determines hardness, dimensional stability, and long‑term performance in service. Machine shops, heat‑treaters, and purchasing
body_text: What Is Quenching? A Practical Guide to Heat Treatment and Quenching Oils In heat‑treat operations, quenching is the point where material properties are finalized. The way steel is cooled after heating determines hardness, dimensional stability, and long‑term performance in service. Machine shops, heat‑treaters, and purchasing teams all benefit from understanding what quenching is, why it’s used, and how different quenching media influence results . When quench media are selected intentionally—rather than by habit—shops reduce distortion, lower scrap rates, and improve process consistency. This guide explains what quenching is, why it matters, the main types of quenching media , and how quench selection affects hardness and distortion in real‑world applications. What Is Quenching? Quenching is a heat‑treatment process in which steel is heated to an austenitizing temperature and then cooled rapidly using a selected medium. The rapid cooling transforms the steel’s internal structure into a hardened form, improving wear resistance and strength. The most important variable in quenching is cooling rate . Cooling too quickly can introduce thermal stress, while cooling too slowly may prevent full hardening. The quenching medium controls how heat is extracted from the part—and how evenly that cooling occurs. Why Is Quenching Used in Heat Treatment? Quenching is used to: Increase hardness and wear resistance Improve load‑bearing performance Create repeatable metallurgical results across production batches However, quenching is always a balance. Excessive quench severity increases the risk of cracking and distortion , while insufficient cooling can leave parts too soft for service. Shops achieve better results when quench media are selected based on: Steel grade and hardenability Part geometry and section thickness Distortion tolerance Required mechanical properties Types of Quenching Media and How They Compare Water and Brine Quenching Water and brine provide very rapid heat extraction , making them the most severe quenching options. Advantages Achieves high hardness quickly Simple and inexpensive Limitations High risk of thermal shock Increased likelihood of cracking and warping Less suitable for alloy steels or complex geometries Water quenching is typically reserved for simple carbon steels or applications where distortion risk is less critical. Oil Quenching Oil quenching provides moderated, more uniform cooling compared to water. Why quench in oil instead of water? Oil reduces thermal gradients during cooling, which lowers internal stress and improves dimensional stability while still supporting effective hardening in many carbon and alloy steels. Because of this balance, oil quenching is widely used in industrial heat‑treat operations. For a deeper look at how quenching oil works and how different oil types are selected, see our article: What Is Quenching Oil? Types, Uses & Selection Guide You can also explore Quaker Houghton’s full range of quenching oils for heat treatment here: Quenching Oils for Heat Treatment Polymer Quenchants Polymer quenchants are water‑based solutions that allow adjustable cooling rates based on concentration. Advantages Tunable quench severity Faster than oil, gentler than water Limitations Requires consistent concentration control Cooling behavior changes with dilution and temperature Polymer systems are often selected when shops need flexibility across multiple steel grades within the same operation. Air or Gas Quenching Air or gas quenching provides slow, controlled cooling . Best suited for Air‑hardening and high‑alloy steels Parts where minimal distortion is critical Because cooling is gradual, air and gas quenching are not used when rapid hardness development is required . How Quench Media Influence Hardness and Distortion The quenching medium directly affects two critical outcomes: hardness and dimensional control . Faster cooling increases hardness potential but raises thermal stress More uniform cooling reduces distortion and cracking Moderated cooling behavior improves repeatability across batches Shops improve consistency when quench media behavior is matched to both material properties and part geometry , rather than using a single approach for all parts. Application Examples Automotive Gears Gear manufacturers often rely on oil quenching to achieve target hardness while maintaining dimensional accuracy across teeth and hubs. Precision Tooling Thin or intricate tools benefit from controlled quenching approaches that reduce internal stress and help preserve tight tolerances. General Alloy Steel Parts Shops processing a wide range of alloy steels often select balanced quenching media to improve repeatability and reduce rework across part families. How Machine Shops Select the Right Quench Medium Heat‑treat and shop teams typically evaluate: Steel composition and hardenability Part geometry and section thickness Required hardness and wear performance Distortion tolerance Furnace type and quench system design Treating quench selection as a **process variable—not a commodity purchase—* *helps shops improve throughput, reduce scrap, and maintain consistent quality. Frequently Asked Questions What is quenching? Quenching is the rapid cooling of heated steel to create a hardened microstructure that improves wear resistance and strength. Why do many shops prefer oil instead of water? Oil quenching moderates cooling speed, and moderated cooling speed reduces cracking and distortion that commonly occur with water. Which steels are commonly quenched in oil? Carbon steels, alloy steels, and tool steels frequently rely on oil quenching because controlled cooling supports consistent hardness. Can quench media affect scrap rates? Yes. Improperly selected media increase cracking, distortion, and uneven hardness, all of which elevate scrap and rework levels. Does oil require more maintenance than water? Oil requires temperature control, filtration, and oxidation monitoring, and these practices extend fluid life and maintain stable quench curves. title: New Grant Program Announced to Support OHV Recreation Access and Safety on Bureau of Land Management Lands
summary: A new partnership is helping fund projects to improve off-road trails and riding areas across the United States: The Foundation for America’s Public Lands and Polaris have joined forces; Award first round of grants to seven projects across four states.
body_text: 6/2/2026 New Grant Program Announced to Support OHV Recreation Access and Safety on Bureau of Land Management Lands The Foundation for America’s Public Lands and Polaris have joined forces; Award first round of grants to seven projects across four states June 1, 2026 (Washington, D.C.) A new partnership is helping fund projects to improve off-road trails and riding areas across the United States. The Foundation for America’s Public Lands , the charitable partner of the Bureau of Land Management (BLM), and Polaris , a global leader in powersports, are providing grants to support off-highway vehicle (OHV) recreation access, safety and the riding experience on BLM lands. The partnership will provide over $700,000 of impact to support OHV projects on BLM lands. The grants will be funded through a $350,000 donation from Polaris and will leverage a dollar-for-dollar match by the Foundation. Support includes funding new and additional signage, as well as trail maintenance and repairs to help support safety, access, and continued use of these OHV spaces. The BLM manages some of the most iconic and beloved motorized recreation areas in the nation, with over 200 designated OHV recreation sites and millions of acres open to responsible motorized recreation. These are places where families, friends, and entire communities gather to spend time outdoors, connect, and build the kind of shared experiences that empower local economies and keep people coming back to ride. “People are deeply connected to the areas they spend their days riding, and we know strong communities are at the heart of maintaining these spaces. Through our new partnership with the Foundation for America’s Public Lands, we will invest alongside local partners to improve trails, promote responsible riding, and support the people who know these areas better than anyone, helping to keep these places thriving,” said Mike Speetzen, Polaris CEO. “We are privileged to work alongside the Foundation, the Bureau of Land Management and local partners to help bring these important projects to life.” "America's public lands are powerful economic drivers and places where Americans can get outside to experience the Great Outdoors," said I Ling Thompson, Chief Executive Officer of the Foundation for America's Public Lands. "BLM lands offer countless opportunities for multiple use recreation, and we are thrilled to partner with Polaris to support local communities and bring much needed funding to these important projects." The partnership officially kicked off over the weekend at North Reno Recreation Area’s “Moon Rocks,” the 19,000 acres of public land that includes the BLM’s OHV area. Hundreds of volunteers gathered to participate in the Friends of Moon Rock’s annual clean-up event at the beloved riding area. Moon Rocks is one of seven locations being awarded a grant as part of the Polaris & Foundation partnership. The Moon Rocks grant is supporting the installation of new portal signs that connect visitors with the site, along with barriers to assist in directing traffic to the main trail head. “It is astounding to see all of these partners, including the Foundation, Polaris, and all of the volunteers coming together to enhance the Moon Rocks Recreation Area." Said Kim Dow, Associate State Director of BLM Nevada. "Without their support and dedication, Moon Rocks would not be what it is today. It is a great demonstration of the Northern Nevada community's dedication and support for our public lands." This partnership will also support the following six projects: Cricket Mountains OHV Trail System (Utah): Riders will have clearer guidance across the entire trail system with a full signage overhaul, including new directional markers, trail maps, and wayfinding signs installed in partnership with the BLM Fillmore Field Office. Greater Three Peaks OHV Riding Area (Utah) : About 4,800 feet of fencing around "the crater" will reduce safety hazards from dense informal routes and irregular terrain, making one of the area's most-used zones more accessible and rideable. Tusher Tunnel, Uranium Arch and Bartlett Alcove (Utah): Updated signage, parking improvements, and site maintenance across three BLM Moab locations will improve the visitor experience and keep these high-traffic areas in good shape for continued use. Fivemile Pass Recreation Area (Utah): Restroom repairs and new kiosks at seven staging areas will enhance amenities at Utah's most loved OHV areas, keeping it welcoming to all riders. Black Canyon Corridor (Arizona): 1,400 new waypoints and interpretive markers will make the corridor easier to navigate and more engaging to explore, with installation led by youth in alignment with the EXPLORE Act. Glendive Short Pines OHV Area (Montana): A shade structure and ADA concrete trail will complete a long-awaited facility, opening the area to visitors of all riding skill levels, all while providing Eastern Montana with a brand recreation destination. The priorities of Polaris and The Foundation's partnership include supporting OHV recreation, promoting safe and responsible off-road riding, enhancing the riding experience in and around the highest use recreation areas, and partnering with local communities on these projects. The Foundation’s mission is to build strategic partnerships, generate private support, and help connect more people and communities to their public lands and waters. These grants and this partnership a part of Polaris’ broader mission to encourage outdoor recreation and support the safety of its riders and the OHV community as a whole. About The Foundation For America’S Public Lands As the official charitable partner of the Bureau of Land Management (BLM), the Foundation for America's Public Lands serves as a convener, partner, and fundraising catalyst to help ensure the health and stewardship of America's public lands and waters today, and for the future. To learn more, visit americaslands.org . About Polaris As the global leader in powersports, Polaris Inc. (NYSE: PII) has been defining and redefining outdoor adventure since 1954. Polaris delivers industry-shaping off-road vehicles, snowmobiles, boats, military, quadricycles, and commercial transportation vehicles, along with an expansive portfolio of parts, garments, and accessories. Its lineup includes some of the most iconic brands in powersports including the RANGER, RZR, Polaris XPEDITION, Bennington pontoons, Slingshot, and more. Headquartered in Minnesota and serving customers in nearly 100 countries, Polaris continues to set the standard for performance, quality, and unmatched service. Explore more at www.polaris.com. title: Connecting AI Agents to Gmail: A Practical OAuth Walkthrough
summary: Gmail looks like a simple integration until you hit consent screens, scope reviews, and expiring tokens. This walkthrough covers what it actually takes to connect an AI agent to Gmail and keep it working in production for real users.
body_text: Gmail Integration is one of the first things teams try to build once their AI agent moves past demos and into real workflows. Reading a user's inbox, drafting replies, or sending email on someone's behalf sounds like a small feature. In practice, Connecting AI Agents to Gmail is one of the more deceptively complicated integrations a developer can take on, mostly because the hard part is not the API itself. It is everything Google requires around it: consent, verification, scopes, and long term token management. This OAuth Walkthrough is written for developers who are about to build this for the first time, or who already tried and got stuck somewhere between "it works on my machine" and "it works in production for real users." We will go step by step, from setup through scaling, and be honest about where most implementations quietly break. Why Gmail Integration Trips Up Most AI Agents Most developers assume Gmail Integration is a simple case of grabbing an API key and making a request. It is not. Gmail sits behind Google's OAuth 2.0 system, which means every action your agent takes on a user's inbox requires that user to explicitly grant permission, and Google to be satisfied that your app is requesting only what it needs. The access token is rarely the part that causes problems. The real friction shows up in three places: First, scope selection. Request too much access and Google may flag your app for additional review before it can go live. Request too little and your agent breaks the moment it tries to send an email instead of just reading one. Second, verification. Any scope Google considers sensitive, which includes most useful Gmail scopes, requires your app to go through a verification process before it can be used by anyone outside a small testing group. Third, the assumption that authentication is a one time setup. It is not. Tokens expire, users revoke access, and admins in Google Workspace environments can restrict what is available at an organization level. An integration that only accounts for the happy path will fail quietly in production. Understanding these three failure points before writing any code will save you from rebuilding half your authentication flow later. Setup: Google Cloud Project, API, and Scopes Before any OAuth code gets written, there is groundwork to lay in Google Cloud. Start by creating a Google Cloud project dedicated to this integration. Avoid reusing a project meant for something unrelated, since scopes, quotas, and verification status are tied to the project itself. Next, enable the Gmail API from the API library within that project. This step is easy to miss and produces a confusing permission error later if skipped. Then comes the part that matters most: choosing gmail api scopes. Google offers a range of Gmail scopes, from read only access to full account management. A few guidelines here: Only request what your agent actually needs right now. If your agent only reads messages, do not request send or delete permissions in advance just in case. Sensitive and restricted scopes trigger Google's app verification process, which can take time. Plan for this early rather than discovering it right before launch. Document why each scope is needed. This becomes useful both for your own team and for Google's verification review, which often asks for exactly this justification. Implementing the OAuth Flow With setup complete, the actual OAuth Walkthrough begins. Register a redirect URI that exactly matches what your application will use, including protocol and trailing slashes. Mismatches here are one of the most common early errors. Generate the authorization URL, which sends the user to Google's consent screen. This is where the user sees exactly what your agent is asking permission to do, so the scopes chosen earlier directly shape what they see. Once the user approves, Google redirects back to your application with an authorization code. Your server exchanges this code for an access token and a refresh token. The access token is short lived and used for actual API calls. The refresh token is long lived and used to get new access tokens without asking the user to log in again. Store both tokens securely. Do not store them in plain text, and do not store them client side. A common and costly mistake is treating token storage as an afterthought rather than a core part of the integration's security model. Making Your First Authenticated Call Once tokens are in place, it is time to prove the integration actually works. Start with a read only call, such as listing recent messages. This confirms your scopes and token exchange are correct without risking any unintended action on the user's account. From there, move to sending an email on the user's behalf. This is a good moment to double check that your scope selection matches the action, since a read only scope will fail silently or return a permission error here. Watch for pagination when listing messages, since Gmail returns results in pages rather than all at once, and watch for rate limits, since sending too many requests too quickly will result in throttled responses rather than immediate failures. Handling Token Refresh in Production This is the part most tutorials gloss over, and the part most production integrations get wrong. Access tokens expire, typically within an hour. Your integration needs to detect this before making a failed call, not after. The standard approach is to check token expiry proactively and refresh ahead of time, rather than waiting for a request to fail. Automate this refresh process so it happens silently in the background. Users should never need to reauthorize simply because an hour passed. There is also the case where a user revokes access entirely, either directly through their Google account settings or through an admin action in a Workspace environment. When this happens, your refresh token stops working, and your integration needs a clear way to detect this and prompt the user to reconnect, rather than failing with an unclear error. Scaling to Multiple Users A working integration for one test account is a very different problem from a working integration for real users at scale. Each user needs their own isolated set of tokens. Credentials should never be shared or mixed between accounts, both for security reasons and because a breach in one user's access should never cascade to others. In Google Workspace environments, admins can restrict which scopes are available to their organization's users, independent of what your app requests. Your integration needs to handle the case where a scope you rely on simply is not available for a given user. Rate limits also change shape at scale. Google applies limits per user and per project, which means an integration that works fine for ten users can start hitting limits at a hundred, not because of overall volume but because of how quickly individual users are being queried. Build This Yourself, or Use an Integration Layer? Everything above is achievable for a single developer or a small team. The honest question is whether it is worth maintaining. Google's OAuth requirements, scope policies, and verification process change over time. A working integration today can require updates a year from now simply because Google adjusted a policy. Add refresh logic, revocation handling, and multi user isolation, and what looked like a weekend project becomes an ongoing maintenance responsibility. This is the exact gap Corsair is built to close. Instead of building and maintaining Gmail authentication from scratch, Corsair handles Google Workspace API authentication , token storage, and refresh logic as part of its integration layer, so your team can focus on what the agent actually does rather than the plumbing underneath it. title: How Chai Creations builds a cohesive visual identity with Photoroom
summary: Learn how Chai Creations is using Photoroom to elevate the presentation of her unique, double-walled, ceramic pieces and build a professional visual identity.
body_text: The challenge: Chai, a psychologist by day and ceramicist by night, started Chai Creations as a creative outlet. As her pottery skills grew, she faced the challenge of presenting her unique double-walled ceramics professionally without investing time and resources into complex photography setups. Our solution: Chai discovered Photoroom through a recommendation from a fellow ceramicist. The app's AI-powered background remover and editing tools allowed her to create professional-looking product photos quickly and easily, even for her complex ceramic pieces. The results: Since adopting Photoroom, Chai Creations has achieved a more professional and cohesive visual identity. The app has saved Chai significant time, allowing her to focus more on creating ceramics. Using AI Backgrounds , she can now explore different presentation styles for her work, even inspiring her booth setups for craft fairs and markets. A journey of creative balance from psychology to pottery When Chai, a school psychologist, started Chai Creations three years ago, it was more than just a hobby—it was an opportunity to find work-life balance and embrace the joy of being a beginner again. "My job title does imply that I'm the expert, I'm supposed to have the answers," Chai explains. "I wanted to be able to get comfortable with the sense of exploring something and being new to something. And ceramics became sort of my medium for that." Starting from scratch, Chai's first attempts at pottery were far from perfect. She describes her first pot as "terrible" with uneven walls and a crack on the bottom. But her persistence paid off. Today, Chai creates complex double-walled pieces that are recognized for their unique style. Chai handles all aspects of her creative practice, from creating ceramics to marketing and promotion. While her business growth has been gradual, it has evolved from serving friends and family to attracting clients who specifically seek out her work. "Now there's a lot more people who know me through my ceramics, including other ceramicists," Chai says proudly. "The first time I get to know them, we connect over my art. " How Photoroom became Chai's go-to photography tool As Chai's skills improved and her business expanded, she faced a new challenge: presenting her work professionally online and in applications for markets and craft shows. The process of setting up for product photography was time-consuming and often frustrating. "I was trying to apply to markets or post on social media in a more professional and aesthetically unified way. And I was having a lot of difficulty with that. Every time I wanted to take a picture, I would hold my phone up and realize I had to clear so many things off the table. By the time I did all of it, the lighting wasn't as good anymore. It was just very frustrating." - Chai, Founder of Chai Creations Chai found herself in a common dilemma for many artisans: the need for professional-looking photos without the resources or desire to invest in complex photography equipment or skills. As far as Chai is concerned, she loves photography as an art form but is not interested in learning it as a skill. A fellow ceramicist suggested trying Photoroom, and Chai was immediately open to it. "I tried the app. And I think I very quickly began spending a lot of time just trying out different features for fun," she says. Now, she uses it a lot for her visuals, especially when creating promotional materials for her pop-ups at a local gift store or farmer’s market. Chai’s favorite Photoroom feature that changed her aesthetics Chai uses Photoroom in several innovative ways to enhance her product photography and streamline her creative process. She primarily relies on the AI Backgrounds feature, which she finds quick and easy to use, especially as someone with no prior photo editing experience. I use Photoroom to make a collection of photos look more aesthetically unified. I might make pieces at different time points or photograph them in different places, so it can look very messy. If I want pieces with the same theme or part of the same series to have a plain pastel background, Photoroom is an easy way to do it. If I bought a physical backdrop, it would all just be the same shade of pink, and that would be a little boring." - Chai, Founder of Chai Creations. Photoroom also allows Chai to enhance the themes of her pieces. For floral-themed ceramics, she adds floral backgrounds, and for pieces with fish motifs, she uses ocean wave backgrounds to increase visual drama. She also uses Photoroom to experiment with different booth setups for craft fairs and markets. She can try various tablecloth options virtually before making a physical purchase, saving time and money. "What always fascinates me is no matter what orientation I take the picture in, the app sort of picks it up so that my art is not floating in the air or in some awkward position. It's like if I stack my cups or if they're taken lying on the ground, the app can somehow make it make sense, as if I brought the piece to the actual place to take the photos." - Chai, Founder of Chai Creations For Chai, Photoroom has been instrumental in professionalizing her brand and saving time. The app has not only improved the presentation of her pieces but also allowed her to focus more on creating. "It makes the presentation of my pieces more professional and saves me a lot of time, which means I'm actually spending more time making things and not being discouraged by the difficulty of photography." - Chai, Founder of Chai Creations Photoroom has helped Chai prioritize what's most important in her practice, which is the art itself. The app allows her to achieve professional results without diverting her focus from ceramics. Looking forward to artistic growth with Photoroom As Chai Creations continues to grow, Chai is excited about participating in more shows in galleries, which allows her to create more conceptual and less practical pieces. She's also looking forward to further exploring her signature double-walled aesthetic. Chai continues to find new ways to use Photoroom, from creating unified collections of her work to experimenting with backgrounds that complement her pieces' themes. "I really enjoy the photos where there's some type of interaction between my piece and the background, and suddenly it goes from being a small piece to feeling much grander and more dramatic." - Chai, Founder of Chai Creations. Chai enthusiastically recommends Photoroom to others, emphasizing its ease of use and the wealth of features available even in the free version. "Just try it out and have fun with it. I think that's what I did and it was very easy to use. I very quickly became excited about trying it for multiple things. - Chai, Founder of Chai Creations Try Photoroom yourself today ! Available on Android , iOS , or the Web . Follow Chai Creations on Instagram to see how Chai continues to use Photoroom to elevate her unique ceramic art.

title: How to Prepare for the 51Talk English Language Assessment
summary: Prepare for the 51Talk English Language Assessment with confidence. Learn what to expect, equipment requirements, speaking tips, and how to succeed online.
body_text: Teaching Techniques Jul 25, 2026 How to Prepare for the 51Talk English Language Assessment Prepare for the 51Talk English Language Assessment with confidence. Learn what to expect, equipment requirements, speaking tips, and how to succeed online. Every completed step brings you closer to starting your teaching journey with 51Talk . Now it's time for the English Language Assessment —an opportunity to showcase your English communication skills, confidence, and readiness to teach learners in an online classroom. While many candidates spend most of their time thinking about what questions they might be asked, successful preparation starts much earlier. Having the right teaching equipment, practicing your spoken English, and creating a professional learning environment can help you perform with confidence and make a positive impression. Whether you're an experienced educator or preparing to become an online English teacher for the first time, this guide will help you understand what to expect and how to prepare for your 51Talk English Language Assessment . Why the English Language Assessment Matters The English Language Assessment is an important milestone in the 51Talk teacher journey. It gives you the opportunity to demonstrate how effectively you communicate in English—one of the most essential skills for teaching learners online. More than evaluating your language proficiency, the assessment also reflects your readiness to teach in a virtual classroom. Preparing in advance allows you to stay focused, communicate confidently, and perform at your best. What to Expect During the English Language Assessment Knowing what to expect before your scheduled assessment can help you feel more confident and perform at your best. The 51Talk English Language Assessment takes approximately 5–10 minutes and is completed online. Throughout the assessment, you'll complete several guided steps designed to evaluate your English communication skills and ensure you're ready for the next stage of the teacher journey. Step 1: Enter the Assessment Room Log in to the Teacher Candidacy Portal and click Start Assessment when you're ready. Before beginning, make sure you've set aside enough uninterrupted time to complete the assessment. Step 2: Watch the Assessment Instructions Take a few minutes to watch the instruction video carefully. It explains what you'll be doing during the assessment and helps you understand the process before you begin. Listening carefully to the instructions can help you avoid common mistakes and complete the assessment with confidence. Step 3: Complete the Device Check Before the assessment starts, the system will guide you through a quick equipment check. You'll be asked to test your: Camera Microphone Speakers Completing these checks ensures everything is working properly so you can focus on the assessment without technical interruptions. Step 4: Complete the Assessment During the assessment, you'll complete several short activities, including: Information Verification – Confirm your personal and educational details. English Reading Activity – Read a short passage aloud to demonstrate your pronunciation, fluency, and spoken English. Professional Conduct Questions – Answer a few simple questions by following the on-screen instructions. Read each instruction carefully and answer every section in English. Prepare Your Equipment Before the Assessment Your preparation begins long before the assessment starts. Reliable equipment helps you avoid unnecessary interruptions and allows you to focus on communicating with confidence. Before your scheduled assessment, make sure you have: A laptop or desktop computer A stable and reliable internet connection A working webcam A clear headset or microphone A quiet, well-lit room with minimal distractions Take a few minutes to test your camera, microphone, speakers, and internet connection before your schedule. Being technically prepared creates a smooth experience and demonstrates professionalism from the very beginning. Tip: Mobile phones and tablets are not supported for the assessment. Complete your assessment using a laptop or desktop computer. Practice Speaking English with Confidence Many candidates believe they need perfect English to succeed. In reality, confidence and clear communication are far more important. The 51Talk English Language Assessment is designed to evaluate how well you communicate your ideas. Focus on speaking naturally rather than trying to sound perfect. To build confidence before your assessment: Practice introducing yourself in English. Read short English passages aloud to improve pronunciation and fluency. Speak at a steady pace and avoid rushing. Use complete sentences whenever possible. Maintain eye contact with the camera and smile naturally. Remember, the goal isn't perfection—it's demonstrating that you can communicate clearly and confidently with learners. Create an Environment That Sets You Up for Success Your surroundings can influence both your confidence and your performance. Choose a place where you can complete the assessment without interruptions. A good assessment environment includes: A quiet room Good lighting A clean, distraction-free background Minimal background noise These simple preparations help you stay focused and allow your communication skills to take center stage. Stay Calm and Be Yourself Every teacher has a unique story and teaching journey. Whether you're a licensed professional teacher, an experienced online educator, a career shifter, a stay-at-home parent, or someone taking the first step toward teaching online, authenticity matters. The assessment is not about memorizing answers. It's an opportunity to demonstrate your communication skills, confidence, professionalism, and enthusiasm for teaching. Relax, stay positive, and let your personality shine throughout the assessment. Need Assistance Before Your Assessment? If you have questions while preparing for the 51Talk English Language Assessment , the AI Assistant available through the website chat is ready to help. It can answer common questions and guide you through the next steps of your teacher journey anytime you need assistance. Continue the Teacher Journey Every successful online teacher begins with preparation. Understanding the assessment process, checking your equipment, practicing your English communication skills, and creating the right environment can help you perform with confidence. Approach your 51Talk English Language Assessment prepared and ready to showcase your potential. After completing the assessment, continue with the remaining steps in the 51Talk teacher journey to move one step closer to successfully starting to teach learners from around the world. Ready to Start Your Teaching Journey? Every great teacher begins with a single step. If you're ready to share your English communication skills, inspire learners, and enjoy the flexibility of teaching online, now is the perfect time to begin. Sign up with 51Talk, complete your registration, and take the first step toward becoming an online English teacher. Your teaching journey starts today. Ready to teach online?
